messages:
ella: Quick postmortem follow-up — the canary triggered auto-rollbacks twice yesterday but our signal surface missed the slow memory leak pattern. We need owners for signal enrichment, a short timeline, and a way to track recurring incidents.

sam: +1. Proposed split: (1) telemetry enrichment (histograms + host-level mem pct), (2) alert tuning (rolling-window anomaly), (3) rollout safety knobs (quarantine window + sample size).

marta: I can own telemetry enrichment. Will add host mem pct and increase sampling to 1s bins. ETA: 1 week for infra changes, 2 weeks for dashboards.

ella: Awesome — Marta for telemetry. Sam, can you take alert tuning? We want a plan that avoids noisy flips but still catches slow drifts.

sam: I’ll take alert tuning. Plan: add 3-stage rule — warn (5% deviation, 15m), escalate (10% dev, 60m), auto-rollback candidate if sustained 10%+ for 2h AND logistic-regression score > 0.8. Will draft rules by EOD Friday.

marta: Notes on metrics: we should include kv-cache evictions and per-request p95 memory. I’ll add two PromQL queries and tag them as canary-only. Snippet: ```
avg_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="runtime",env="canary"}[5m]) / avg_over_time(container_memory_limit_bytes{job="runtime",env="canary"}[5m])
```

nayan: deploy-bot recorded the fallback: "canary-auto-rollback: 1739951022 - rollback triggered for model-serving v2.3.4 -> v2.3.3 (reason: latency+oom pattern)." Keeping log here so we can correlate metrics.

ella: Important action items (compact):
- telemetry enrichment: owner=marta, due=7d, tasks=[host mem pct, kv-cache evictions, p95 mem]
- alert rules: owner=sam, due=3d, tasks=[3-stage rule, anomaly window tuning, false-positive runbook]
- rollout knobs: owner=ella, due=5d, tasks=[quarantine window default=30m, min sample=200 reqs, auto-rollback cooldown=6h]

sam: For rollout knobs, suggest adding a soft-quarantine that scales sample size down to 10% for the next 30m instead of immediate full rollback, to gather more signal. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

marta: Agree on soft-quarantine. Also we should tag any canary with a unique run_id and persist histograms for 48h for postmortem. I’ll update the schema.

ella: Can we create a small recurring kanban card for recurring incidents tracking? Weekly triage to inspect any canary rollbacks and mark patterns (oom, latency, data). Owner: ops-rotating.

sam: I’ll spin up a ticket: RL-5421 "Canary Signal Enrichment + Auto-Rollback Playbook" with the above owners and deadlines.

marta: Quick checklist item — include a simple repro guide in the ticket so SRE oncall can run a containment test.

deploy-bot: Reminder: Next scheduled canary run = 1739958000. No action required from bot aside from logging.

ella: Thanks team. I’ll follow up in two days with a merged playbook draft. :thumbsup:
